overview: A Repair and Maintenance clause in a lease defines whether the landlord or tenant is responsible for property upkeep, structural repairs, and HVAC systems. Typically, landlords manage major structural components (roof, foundation), while tenants handle daily maintenance, routine repairs, and damages they cause. Clear definitions prevent disputes, often covering common areas, plumbing, and electrical systems.
